scenarios.HEALTHY_ON_TRACK: Progress and operational inputs remain close to plan.
scenarios.PHYSICAL_PROGRESS_LAG: Actual physical progress remains materially behind plan.
scenarios.PHYSICAL_STAGNATION: Physical progress is unchanged across recent valid months.
scenarios.HIGH_REQUIRED_FUTURE_VELOCITY: Remaining work implies an unusually high monthly pace.
scenarios.FINANCIAL_BEHIND_PLAN: Compatible actual financial progress remains behind plan.
scenarios.FINANCIAL_PHYSICAL_DIVERGENCE: Financial and physical progress diverge materially.
scenarios.WORSENING_MILESTONE_SLIPPAGE: Milestone slippage increases over compatible observations.
scenarios.LAND_ACQUISITION_PENDING: Structured land evidence reports acquisition incomplete.
scenarios.LAND_DEADLINE_CONFLICT: Expected land completion falls after a relevant milestone.
scenarios.ROW_PENDING: Structured right-of-way evidence reports pending work.
scenarios.TENDER_AWARD_PENDING: A published applicable tender has no reported award.
scenarios.PROLONGED_TENDER_CYCLE: The tender cycle exceeds the governed threshold.
scenarios.REPORTING_GAP: A deliberate source gap interrupts the observation sequence.
scenarios.STALE_REPORTING: The latest structured update is explicitly stale.
scenarios.POOR_PROVENANCE: Required synthetic evidence provenance is deliberately incomplete.
scenarios.RECOVERY_AFTER_STAGNATION: Progress resumes after a controlled stagnant interval.
scenarios.IMPROVING_PROJECT: Observable implementation pressure declines over time.
scenarios.MULTI_PRESSURE_PROJECT: Several independent observable pressure signals coexist.
scenarios.DATA_INSUFFICIENT_PROJECT: Structured evidence is deliberately insufficient for Watch evaluation.
